stemMd: A cube has total surface area 150 cm². What is its volume?
explanationMd: If edge length is s, surface area is 6s² = 150. Thus s² = 25 and s = 5 cm. Volume is s³ = 125 cm³. First recover the linear dimension before cubing it.

distractorRationale.c: This is the area of one face numerically.
distractorRationale.b: This relabels the given surface area as volume.
distractorRationale.e: This divides the surface area without finding the edge.
distractorRationale.d: This uses an edge length of ten rather than five.
